conflicts.permit: In connection with, or during negotiations of, any merger, sale of company assets, consolidation or restructuring, financing, or acquisition of all or a portion of our business by or into another company;
conflicts.prohibit: We respect your privacy and take measures to keep your data safe, to never sell your personal data and to be as transparent as possible.
conflicts.situation: When Zum engages in a sale of company assets that involves transferring personal data for consideration.
conflicts.reason: The policy makes an absolute commitment to never sell personal data, but also permits sharing personal data in connection with a sale of company assets without an exception.
